about_the_game:
Welcome to this exciting 3D VR zombie survival game, get ready to experience the thrill of adrenaline rush!

[img][/img]

In a world controlled by an evil company, hordes of zombies are about to be activated and become an extremely powerful threat. As a brave player, you will become an extraordinary police officer and face the impending zombie apocalypse.

In this challenging environment, your task is to drive your vehicle, use speed and power to hit and destroy these terrible zombies. The big bear police on duty found them, but the bullets have been used up. You will become the last line of defense for mankind with wisdom and courage. Come and experience this exciting battle, feel the pleasure of every collision, and save the world from the impending disaster!

Are you ready for the challenge? Join us, become a zombie hunter, and write your own heroic legend!

[img][/img]

Operation instructions:

Throttle: L/R handle up/down

Steering: L/R handle left/right

Menu: Menu button

Reset: L/R handle
